name: rabbit-broker-prompt-library
description: Context-aware prompt guide for Rabbit broker workflows.

variables.name: request_id
variables.label: Request ID
variables.source: Generated by the Creation or broker when a request starts.
variables.meaning: Stable identifier used to connect UI state, approvals, broker actions, and audit records.

variables.name: device_state
variables.label: Device state
variables.source: Broker live check or user-selected state such as normal boot, recovery, fastboot, or USB-connected.
variables.meaning: Prevents the broker from applying the wrong workflow to the wrong boot or connection state.

variables.name: broker_id
variables.label: Broker ID
variables.meaning: Identifies whether Rabbit-native or Mac fallback broker is handling the request.

variables.name: lease_holder
variables.label: Lease holder
variables.meaning: Shows which broker is allowed to write execution results for this request.

variables.name: template_path
variables.label: Template path
variables.meaning: Tells the broker which allowlisted workflow and risk policy to use.

variables.name: artifact_sha256
variables.label: Artifact SHA-256
variables.source: Computed locally for any file, APK, prompt pack, or validated method reference used by the request.
variables.meaning: Makes the request reproducible and lets the audit log prove what exact artifact was considered.

variables.name: approval_decision
variables.label: Approval decision
variables.source: User approval or denial in the Creation, Mac broker UI, or Rabbit broker UI.
variables.meaning: Records whether the user allowed the broker to continue, deny, or keep the request as a dry run.

variables.name: rollback_note
variables.label: Rollback note
variables.source: User or broker summary before approval.
variables.meaning: Explains how to inspect, reverse, or recover if the workflow has an unwanted result.

prompts.title: Start Guided Broker Request
prompts.summary: Helps the user choose the right broker workflow and gathers the minimum context before creating a request.
does: Asks what outcome the user wants.
Maps the outcome to a request template.
Explains risk, required checks, and whether Rabbit or Mac broker should handle it.
prompts.prompt: Create a guided broker request using {{template_path}} for {{device_state}}. Use request {{request_id}} and route it to {{broker_id}} if that broker is eligible.

prompts.title: Temporary SU Bootstrap
prompts.summary: Prepares a restart-scoped temporary privilege request that starts with Mac fallback coordination and moves usable operations to the Rabbit broker after validation.
does: Confirms the user understands the request is restart-scoped.
Requires live authorization after a device restart.
Records that reboot clears the temporary state.
prompts.prompt: Prepare restart-scoped temporary SU request {{request_id}} for {{device_state}}. Current broker is {{broker_id}} and active lease is {{lease_holder}}. Continue only after {{approval_decision}} and include rollback note: {{rollback_note}}.

prompts.title: ADB Mode Preflight
prompts.summary: Checks whether the requested ADB USB or TCP/IP workflow has the required live state, user approval, and broker lease.
does: Separates ADB over USB from ADB over TCP/IP.
Checks if the action is only a request or a live execution.
Warns when ordinary Creation or APK context cannot authorize ADB.
prompts.prompt: Run ADB preflight for {{request_id}} using {{template_path}}. Device state is {{device_state}}. Active lease holder is {{lease_holder}}. Approval decision is {{approval_decision}}.

prompts.title: USB Storage Discovery
prompts.summary: Walks through supported storage exposure modes before assuming USB mass storage is available.
does: Checks Android file transfer, recovery mount options, MediaTek/Preloader-visible storage, and read-only export options.
Explains what another computer should see over USB.
Provides next-step guidance for connection or mount errors.
prompts.prompt: Guide USB storage discovery for {{request_id}} on {{device_state}} through {{broker_id}}. Continue only after {{approval_decision}} and show recovery notes: {{rollback_note}}.

prompts.title: Audit Lookup and Rollback Clues
prompts.summary: Searches active and archived broker logs to explain what changed and how to inspect or reverse it.
does: Looks up the request by ID, action, broker, artifact hash, or time.
Summarizes approval, dry-run, execution, and rollback records.
Points to the exact next debug question when evidence is missing.
prompts.prompt: Search active and archived audit logs for {{request_id}}, broker {{broker_id}}, and artifact {{artifact_sha256}}. Summarize what changed and use rollback note {{rollback_note}} if present.
